profile.headline: A Java, Cloud and Full Stack Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced Senior Java Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Involved in designing and building complex software applications for various financial, Travel and Retail sector. 

Skill Sets : Java, J2EE, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Spring JPA, Spring Security, Restful API Services, SOAP Webservices, Struts 1.2/Struts 2.0, Hibernate, junit, Mockito, Maven, Gradle, GIT, SVN, CVS, Jenkins

Cloud Technologies : Amazon Web Services AWS S3, AWS IAM, AWS EC2, LAMBDA, API Gateways, SNS, SQS, SES, Code pipelines, Amplify and building serverless application in AWS.
AWS SDK for JAVA and AWS CLI.
Azure DevOps (CI/CD).

DB Skills : Dynamo DB, Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL, IBM DB2.

UX Skills : React, Bootstrap, JSP, HTML, CSS, jQuery, JavaScript, JSX.
